english: Optional. While you log shots, Korf Log quietly looks through your video file for the ball around each shot and remembers where it was. That makes "Check times" later much quicker, and gives Korf Lab ready-made ball positions for "Crop follows the ball" in highlight reels. It uses your computer for as long as you track, so keep this tab open and visible, and it can slow older computers down a little. Nothing leaves your computer. Leave it off if you only want to track.

Het gebruikt je computer zolang je logt, dus houd dit tabblad open en zichtbaar; oudere computers kunnen er een beetje trager van worden. Er verlaat niets je computer.
